About

The person behind the frame

I like the quiet part of a photograph, the moment before anything is said.

I’m Khaleel, a model, actor and musician from Srinagar, Kashmir. I trained as a civil engineer, which taught me to read proportion, structure and light. I bring the same eye to a frame, whether it is a tailored suit in a warm interior or a shirt and trousers in the last light of the day.

My style is old money: classic tailoring, quiet colours and a cinematic sense of nostalgia. Still, deliberate, never loud. I play all sports (football, table tennis, badminton and basketball), which keeps me disciplined and quick, and music keeps me listening. Acting is where all of it comes together, and it is the direction I want my career to take, alongside editorial and commercial modelling.

I am looking for a first step into fashion, advertising and film, and I am ready to work for it.

Acting

Profile

Stillness first. The camera finds the rest.

I came to acting through the camera. Holding a look, letting a thought cross my face and trusting a quiet frame are the things I work on most. I’m drawn to period pieces, character-led drama and the kind of cinema that lets a silence carry a scene.

I recently worked on a web series, which is yet to be released.

I speak English, Hindi / Urdu and Kashmiri, and I perform and play music, which helps with rhythm, timing and listening on set.

Hazel, in every light

My eye colour changes with the light. It reads honey gold in the sun, warm amber-brown in golden light and olive-brown indoors. These close-ups are untouched, so the colour is true.
